The mlx-swift-lm bump likely moves GatedDelta.swift from MLXLLM/Models to MLXLMCommon, matching the doc path change and the qualified type name. The contents of the new commits are unverified. They run in-process on decrypted prompts and KV state (TB-007, T-028, T-041, A-001), and may change inference kernels, the prefix cache or the memory contract. This is a coverage limit, not evidence of a regression. Integration should confirm that the pinned submodule commits are reviewed upstream and that no security-relevant behavior changed, such as cache scoping, encryption, or env-var forwarding.
